objective: Golden Path Public Demo Orchestration: Full end-to-end user journey from Landing page to completed legal case with evidence trail, demonstrating EOS shared rails across all three products

work_items.name: ORCHESTRATION: Build public demo replay script for golden user journey
acceptance: Replay script automates the full golden path: Landing → Signup → Workspace → Consultation → Case Creation → Lifecycle Progression → Outcome
Script uses Playwright to simulate real user browser interactions, no mocks, no test stubs
Script records full execution video and screenshots for demo presentation
Script validates all golden path states are preserved across page refreshes
Replay runs in <90 seconds, meets public demo performance requirements
All capabilities used are existing primitives, no new code created, 100% reuse
User never sees EOS/capability jargon, experience feels like one unified product

work_items.name: VERIFICATION: Independent end-to-end golden path verification
acceptance: Verification agent independently executes the replay script
All acceptance criteria of GOLDEN-001 are verified
Tenant isolation is enforced (no cross-tenant data leakage)
Session persistence is verified across server restarts
Evidence ledger captures all interactions with correct attribution
All Postgres records are created and persist correctly
Final verdict: ALL_PASSED or FAILED with concrete failures

work_items.name: EVIDENCE: Consolidate demo-ready artifacts package
acceptance: Package includes replay script, execution video, screenshots, build logs, typecheck logs
Package contains primitive reuse calculation (96.4% per GOLDEN-001 recon)
Package is ready for public demo presentation
All evidence is verifiable by third-party auditors
